result.title: FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing
result.summary: Layered image generation separates images into compositable layers, allowing users to manipulate individual elements independently. However, such asset-level editability does not enable the generation system to interpret successive feedback, perform targeted edits, and preserve unaffected content. We introduce FolioWeaver, a LayerGraph-grounded agent that unifies layered-image generation and iterative editing through a persistent Executable Scene State. FolioWeaver constructs a LayerGraph and generates independent visual assets conditioned on a shared scene reference. An Editing Agent performs feedback-driven modifications and self-repair through scoped actions, selective layer execution, and visual verification, enabling targeted updates while reusing unchanged assets. We also publicly release LayerFolio, a dataset of 100,377 human-reviewed layered scenes spanning six visual domains, together with two evaluation protocols: AtomicQA for measuring requirement satisfaction and CBLP for assessing layer organization. Experiments demonstrate that FolioWeaver achieves superior layer organization and composite fidelity compared with direct layered-generation methods. Analyses validate the contributions of component adaptation, execution-grounded repair, and cross-domain training. FolioWeaver advances layered-image generation toward persistent, controllable, and iterative visual creation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FolioWeaver/LayerFolio.

AI.brief_summary: FolioWeaver 以 LayerGraph 组织分层图像资产，用持久化的 Executable Scene State 支撑反馈驱动的定向编辑与自我修复，并发布 LayerFolio 数据集及 AtomicQA、CBLP 两项评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持久状态＋选择性执行＋视觉验证修复」的循环，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的维护、局部更新与证据核验提供类比线索；但对象是可编辑图层资产而非 latent 推理表示，需核查。
